queries: WITH s AS (SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) AS a FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), o AS (SELECT AVG(modelconf) AS m FROM compliancecase), q AS (SELECT s.brokrepstat, s.a, o.m FROM s CROSS JOIN o WHERE s.a > o.m) SELECT brokrepstat, a AS avg_modelconf, a - m AS amount_above_overall_avg, a / AVG(a) OVER () AS ratio_to_mean_of_qualifying_avgs FROM q

assumptions.assumption: The 'average' benchmark is the overall mean modelconf across all compliance cases (row-level, NULL modelconf ignored). A status qualifies if its own average is strictly greater than this. If that overall average is NULL, no rows are returned.
Cases with NULL brokrepstat form their own group (shown as a NULL status). Statuses whose modelconf values are all NULL have a NULL average and do not qualify.
The ratio divides each qualifying status's average by the unweighted mean of the qualifying statuses' averages. Values are not rounded.

responses.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) AS a FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), o AS (SELECT AVG(modelconf) AS m FROM compliancecase), q AS (SELECT g.brokrepstat, g.a, o.m FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE g.a > o.m) SELECT brokrepstat, a AS avg_modelconf, a - m AS diff_above_overall_avg, a / AVG(a) OVER () AS ratio_to_mean_of_qualifying_avgs FROM q

assumptions.assumption: The reference 'average' is the overall mean modelconf across all compliance cases (row-level, NULL modelconf ignored). Each status's average is compared with it. If the overall mean is NULL, no rows are returned.
Cases with a NULL brokrepstat form their own group. A group whose modelconf values are all NULL has a NULL average and is not returned.

'How far above average' is the plain difference (status average minus overall average), not a percentage. The ratio is the status average divided by the mean of the qualifying statuses' averages. No rounding is applied.

alternatives.interpretation: The reference average is the mean of the per-status averages (each status weighted equally), not the row-level mean.
